[[File:PDT-8.jpg|250px|thumb|The PDT-8 was a mini rig.]]
'''Mini rig''' was the name given to a category of small vehicles. The [[PDT-8 Personnel Deployment Transport]] was considered a mini rig.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|15|PDT-8}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The term "mini rig" is a reference to the PDT-8 originating as one of the vehicles from [[Kenner Products|Kenner's]] [[Mini-Rigs]] toys.<ref name="Kenner">{{KennerCite|set=Mini-Rigs|pack=PDT-8 (Personnel Deployment Transport)|link=vintminiPDT8.asp}}</ref> Though many of those vehicles appeared in fiction,<ref name="Offscreen">{{SW|url=news/offscreen-but-not-forgotten-mini-rigs-body-rigs-and-other-kenner-vehicles|text=Offscreen, but Not Forgotten: Mini-Rigs, Body-Rigs, and Other Kenner Vehicles|int=Offscreen, but Not Forgotten: Mini-Rigs, Body-Rigs, and Other Kenner Vehicles|nolive=1}}</ref> no others were called mini rigs.
